title: Link discovery
description: What a gateway returns on its link for a GET of /.well-known/qory-configuration: where the session posts its events, the heartbeat interval, where it opens a run, and the gateway's proxy address. Unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. It lists no node, no server key and no secrets endpoint, which are the gateway's toward the server. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

events.description: Where the session posts its batches, which events, and the run's heartbeat interval. On the local link the URL is http://localhost and a path; behind a separate gateway it has the origin of session.gateway.url.

interval_seconds.description: The gateway's heartbeat interval, which its registration of the run announces toward the server: the session sends its heartbeats every interval_seconds, and the gateway ends a run whose session sends nothing for 3 × interval_seconds from the run answer, session_lost.

run.description: Where the session opens a run, with a POST of its run request. On the local link the URL is http://localhost and a path; behind a separate gateway it has the origin of session.gateway.url.

proxy.description: The gateway's proxy: the one address every connection of the run's agent traffic goes to, opened with QORY-RELAY and the run's proxy secret. On one machine an address on loopback; behind a separate gateway the gateway's one address.

address.description: host:port, the host a name, an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address in brackets, and a port from 1 to 65535.
